whatIsRCT.title: What Is Root Canal Treatment?
whatIsRCT.description: Root canal treatment (RCT) is a dental procedure used to remove infected or damaged pulp from inside a tooth. The canals are thoroughly cleaned, disinfected, and sealed to prevent future infection while preserving your natural tooth.
whatIsRCT.footnote: If you're experiencing persistent tooth pain or sensitivity, searching for root canal treatment near me is the first step toward relief.

steps.title: Consultation & Digital Examination
steps.description: A detailed dental examination and X-rays are performed to evaluate the extent of infection and determine the best treatment plan.

steps.description: The affected area is completely numbed to ensure a comfortable and pain-free procedure.

steps.description: The infected pulp is carefully removed, and the canals are cleaned, disinfected, and shaped using advanced instruments.

steps.title: Sealing the Tooth
steps.description: The cleaned canals are sealed with a specialized filling material to prevent future infection.

steps.title: Final Restoration
steps.description: A dental crown or permanent filling is placed to restore the tooth's strength, appearance, and function.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions – Root Canal Treatment Near Me

items.question: How long does a root canal treatment take?
items.answer: Most root canal treatments are completed in one or two appointments, depending on the complexity of the tooth and the severity of the infection.

items.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
items.answer: Modern root canal treatment is performed under local anesthesia, making the procedure comfortable. Most patients experience little to no pain during treatment.

items.question: How long does a root canal-treated tooth last?
items.answer: With proper oral hygiene and regular dental check-ups, a treated tooth can last for many years.

items.question: Who is a suitable candidate for root canal treatment?
items.answer: Anyone with an infected, damaged, or severely decayed tooth may be a suitable candidate after a dental examination.

items.question: What is the cost of root canal treatment in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the tooth involved, the complexity of treatment, and whether a dental crown is required. A consultation provides an accurate estimate.

items.question: Why choose root canal treatment instead of tooth extraction?
items.answer: Root canal treatment preserves your natural tooth, maintains proper chewing function, prevents shifting of adjacent teeth, and supports long-term oral health.
